name: Smart Kitchen Assistant
description: Kitchen-assistant brain for the Smart Kitchen Assistant app: recipe suggestions from ingredients, step-by-step dish tutorials and conversation summaries via host sampling/createMessage (no API key).
_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish`; the dev fields (tool_id/type/enabled) are read by `anna-app dev`. This dir is the `my-first-anna-app` handle referenced by app.json#bundled_executas. Place downloaded GitHub Release archives into executas/my-first-anna-app/dist/ and flip distribution.active to 'binary' (or pass --profile binary) when publishing binaries.
